fieldAssetRule: Field Assets are one-use operational holdings. levels.title: Level I - Reflected Trajectory
levels.text: Before each battle, select one weapon profile equipped by the chosen model. Each time this unit is selected to shoot or fight, re-roll one Hit roll made with that profile during that activation.

levels.title: Level II - Parallel Impact
levels.text: Retain Level I. Each time this unit is selected to shoot or fight, also re-roll one Wound roll made with the selected profile during that activation. Requirement: after Level I, destroy four enemy units with that profile across at least three battles, survive each, and have Kalagan's forge or a comparable claimant authenticate the second solution without accepting sole ownership.

levels.title: Level III - Phase-Buffered Hull
levels.text: Retain Levels I-II. Models in this unit have Feel No Pain 6+. Requirement: after Level II, survive five battles and end at least three with one or more models at half their starting wounds or fewer; stabilise the engine with an intact alien phase-control component without erasing the recipient's established machine identity.

levels.title: Level IV - Duplex Command Logic
levels.text: Retain Levels I-III. Models in this unit ignore modifiers to their Move, Leadership, and OC characteristics and to Advance and Charge rolls, except modifiers imposed by Battle Scars. Requirement: after Level III, destroy five enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE units across at least four battles and survive each recorded battle; establish two independent command authorities without dividing the recipient's machine spirit.

levels.title: Level V - Matter Accepts Both Answers
levels.text: Retain Levels I-IV. Add one additional Vehicle model to this unit. It copies the selected recipient model's current datasheet, independently selects any legal wargear, costs no points, and may take the unit above normal size, points, and Epic Hero uniqueness limits. Requirement: after Level IV, survive seven additional battles; in one, destroy two enemy MONSTER or VEHICLE units and complete a mission objective with this unit; recover enough impossible matter and formal campaign authority to recognize both vehicles as one unit.

levels.title: Loss Condition
levels.text: If the recipient unit is destroyed, recover the Duplex-Engine or this Honour is lost.
